provenance.note: NOT yet recorded from a real run: no H100 was available when this gate was written, so the floors are conservative a-priori bounds rather than measured ones. Qwen3-0.6B answering 5 short prompts sequentially on one H100 should clear them by a wide margin; they exist to catch a catastrophic regression (a model that serves garbage, or a serving path that falls back to something an order of magnitude slower). Tighten them by running the nightly with --record, which halves the observed values and fills in this block.
